pipeline.label: Figma manifest export
pipeline.role: Ground truth — node.type (TEXT, VECTOR, ELLIPSE, …). Images only via IMAGE fills / imageHash.

pipeline.label: manifestToContract adapter
pipeline.role: Must preserve manifest node kinds — TEXT stays layer.text, no PNG stamping.

pipeline.label: Contract on disk
pipeline.role: Must match adapter output. If kinds differ from manifest → fix adapter or remove post-adapter mutator.

pipeline.label: Live test harness
pipeline.role: Runs adapter + sends contract to Figma. Must NOT call applyLiveHebrewTextRasters / applyStorybookReferenceRasters on vsFigmaLive.

pipeline.label: Figma live importer
pipeline.role: Renders contract as Figma nodes — only when contract kinds are correct.
